text:
Power 
 Station | Technical 
 Procedure
Introduction
This 
 document outlines the equipment inspection I1 which must be performed 
 on an annually bases as indicated by Y1 in the title block.
The pump (figure1) function: to deliver oil to the oil heating station and 
 then to the suction side of the high pressure pumps.
The first draft initiated by eng. Ahmed Mohamed Bakr, reviewed by eng. Omar 
 Hamed Ibrahem, tested by 
 eng. El-Sayed Abd Elrehim Mohamed, accepted by eng. Farag Hamza Farag, approved 
 by eng. Abdel Mohsen Abdel Ghafar: Head Sector of Kafr Eldawar Power Station.
This document certified by eng. Mona Ahmed Al Sharqawy: head sector of 
 inspection and quality control head sector.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued and the maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding 
 the work area is required.
Disconnect the power supply for this pump and tag it out.
Isolate
 the power 
 mechanically by closing the suction and delivery valves and drain it.
Tools and Equipment
Complete maintenance tool set.
Cleaning fluid, Feeler gauge
Grease and Grease gun
Manual puller, Alignment device.
Work to be Carried Out
Check the alignment of the pump
Ensure there is no any leakage from the pump.
Ensure there is no any abnormal noise or vibration.
Check the pressure in the delivery of the pump.
Ensure there is no any leakage from the packing.
Inject new grease using grease gun.
